description: Six stereo core frames, the fourth with FSIZE 60, which no frame can have (a frame has at least 96 bytes).

skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the frame whose FSIZE is 60 (dca_core.c: 'Invalid core frame size')
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser keeps the damaged bytes in the packets around them.
skip.libdca: libdca's tool stops at a frame size it rejects (frame sizes under 96 bytes).
